items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And you’re the only one, probably, who can say that because I’ve asked so many other people – what’s his real name? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Real name, yeah.

ctx.x: And you’re the only one, probably, who can say that because I’ve asked so many other people – what’s his real name?
And people take the wildest stabs and they always get it wrong.
